answer: A sybil tax makes bulk fake identities pay before they can earn. Each agent pays a $6 entry tax to join the mesa market, where a willow grove of honest traders already works; the tax is burned, not refunded, and a walnut seller who pays once keeps trading. Forging 1,000 identities costs $6,000 in burned taxes, far above the gain from one fake vote, while an honest agent pays $6 once and keeps its full reward undiluted by fakes.
